from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The full title/name of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) as stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., 判决书，裁定书，etc.)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
